description: This file contains a JUnit test class for the FileBasedRegistrationService. It includes setup, mocks dependencies like FileSystem and Vertx, and tests various behaviors such as startup behavior, file creation, loading/saving device data, and configuration effects. It verifies that the service correctly interacts with the file system and handles edge cases.

classes.name: FileBasedRegistrationServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for FileBasedRegistrationService, testing its startup, file interactions, device loading, and configuration behaviors.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and the registration service before each test.

methods.name: getRegistrationService
methods.description: Returns the registration service instance for testing.

methods.name: getDeviceManagementService
methods.description: Returns the device management service instance.

methods.name: testSaveToFileCreatesFile
methods.description: Verifies that a file is created if it does not exist when saving device data.

methods.name: testDoStartCreatesFile
methods.description: Checks if the service creates the file during startup if it does not exist.

methods.name: testDoStartFailsIfFileCannotBeCreated
methods.description: Tests startup failure when the service cannot create the required file.

methods.name: testDoStartIgnoresMalformedJson
methods.description: Ensures startup proceeds even if the device data file contains malformed JSON.

methods.name: testDoStartLoadsDeviceIdentities
methods.description: Verifies device identities are loaded correctly from a file at startup.

methods.name: testLoadDevicesCanReadOutputOfSaveToFile
methods.description: Checks that the saved device registry data can be reloaded correctly.

methods.name: testDoStartIgnoreIdentitiesIfStartEmptyIsSet
methods.description: Verifies that device identities are ignored during startup if startEmpty is true.

methods.name: testAddDeviceFailsIfDeviceLimitIsReached
methods.description: Ensures device limit per tenant is enforced and additional device creation is blocked.

methods.name: testUpdateDeviceFailsIfModificationIsDisabled
methods.description: Checks that device modification is prevented if modificationEnabled is false.

methods.name: testRemoveDeviceFailsIfModificationIsDisabled
methods.description: Verifies that device removal is blocked if modificationEnabled is false.

methods.name: testPeriodicSafeJobIsNotScheduledIfSavingIfDisabled
methods.description: Ensures no periodic save job is scheduled if saveToFile is false.

methods.name: testContentsNotSavedOnShutdownIfSavingIfDisabled
methods.description: Verifies that no save occurs on shutdown if saveToFile is false.
